title: Update Contact page CTA button text

requirements.text: On the Contact page CTA section, update the primary button label text from "Book Now" to "Chat Now".

quotes: In the Contact page, change the word "Book Now" to "Chat Now"

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Contact page, the CTA button that previously displayed "Book Now" now displays "Chat Now".
No other button labels or headings are changed as part of this update.

requirements.text: On the Contact page CTA section, update the secondary button label text from "Send Message Instead" to "Email Us".

quotes: and change "Send Message Instead" to "Email Us"

acceptanceCriteria: When viewing the Contact page, the secondary CTA button that previously displayed "Send Message Instead" now displays "Email Us".
The button’s behavior (scrolling to the contact form) remains unchanged unless explicitly updated in a future request.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Keep changes limited to the Contact page UI text; no backend changes are required.
nonGoals: Changing any Contact page button actions/links (e.g., WhatsApp or scrolling behavior).
Updating copy on other pages or components beyond the two specified strings.
